dataQuality.message: Dials, connects and talk time are read live from GHL call records (setters dial from the CRM) covering the last 30 days, so the Today/7d/30d/MTD/QTD windows are exact; YTD and All only include calls from the last 30 days. GHL reports a null duration on some completed calls, so talk time is a floor, not an exact total.

These GHL users are dialing from the CRM but are not on the active SDR roster, so their calls count in the floor totals but not in a setter row: Unknown user (pzeMaT…) (883 dials), Mary Lim (468 dials), Unknown user (JWCZpI…) (264 dials), Unknown user (bp7DRI…) (75 dials). Confirm whether they should be added to the roster.
2155 contacts are stuck carrying the sid-dial-1 toggle tag, which means dial pairs are not completing and attempt counts are not incrementing correctly. Check WF-2 before trusting attempt numbers.
Form compliance is 0 percent of connected calls, under target. Per-setter attribution depends on the Intro Call Form, so low-compliance setters are undercounted.

Sophia and Heart have no matching GHL user account, so their outbound calls cannot be attributed and their Dials / Connects / Talk Time show a dash (only their Intro Call Form activity is counted). Give them GHL user logins to dial under for full per-setter call attribution.

1690 of 2413 dials (70%) are not attributed to anyone on the roster, including 3 GHL user ids the user list did not name (pzeMaTtiI7vnhomwOwYW, JWCZpIdcMd6aAHzW6laO, bp7DRIU4662R75YdBqtk). Per-setter dials, connects and talk time understate the floor by that much. Add the dialer to activeSetters in config, or give the person a GHL user account, so their calls land on their row.
